results.title: Kokuhaku
results.overview: During an interview, Tadashi, a young Spanish-Japanese actor who plays female characters in a theatrical practice similar to kabuki, will return to the past to relive his most intimate memories.

results.title: My Mother is a Cow
results.overview: Left in her aunt’s care on a family ranch at the edge of the burning Brazilian wetland, 12-year-old Mia is desperate for the touch of her mother’s love. Amidst the volatile natural world and the looming threat of a deadly jaguar, love manifests in unexpected ways.

results.title: To Use a Mountain
results.overview: Six rural American communities are marked as candidates for an unthinkable fate: their land, a burial ground for 77,000 tons of nuclear waste. Against the impassive logic of government analysis and archives, a people’s history of resistance and stewardship emerges through a visceral journey across the landscapes, ecologies, and personal histories of the candidate sites.

results.title: Chaotic Evil
results.overview: Four friends gather for a basement game, pushing their imaginations and their host’s patience toward increasingly chaotic extremes.

results.title: Halloween Night
results.overview: A mysterious serial killer hunts down a young man waiting for his ride to a Halloween party.

results.title: Gunman
results.overview: A former hitman accepts a minor job for his former boss. However, in a corrupt neighborhood, nothing is what it seems, and he quickly gets caught in a web of unexpected events. A race against time and his own destiny.

results.title: The Inquisitor
results.overview: In 1972, Congresswoman Barbara Jordan became the first Southern Black woman to join Congress, one of many firsts in her career as a trailblazing political leader. Looking at her life both in and out of the limelight, this insightful documentary explores how her voice still resonates today.

results.title: Lockbox
results.overview: Alex, a degenerate gambler in debt to a gangster, is given a choice. Pick up and deliver ten mysterious lockboxes to a Los Angeles crime boss - or take a bullet to the head.

results.title: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries: Blessings in Disguise
results.original_title: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries: Blessings in Disguise
results.overview: After Cheryl's 3-year engagement ends in a devastating breakup, her life is turned upside down when her aunt offers her an escape from Chicago to the Amish town of Sugarcreek. Struggling with being a fish out of water, Cheryl uncovers an unsettling secret that could disrupt the small town of Ohio. As Cheryl begins to solve the mystery, she finds community, belonging and the potential of new love. Will Sugarcreek become Cheryl's new home?

results.title: Madrid, Ext.
results.overview: A film essay about the city and the passage of time, its transformations and contradictions. It is a tribute to Madrid as a great visual and sound archive of its inhabitants and locations where commerce and fauna, architecture and ladies, haberdasheries and poets, builders and destroyers of the city intersect.

results.title: Hot Pot Artist
results.overview: Li Ruyi is a young man from Northeast China. His film director career is not going as planned and his father-in-law is trying to persuade Ruyi to take over his hot pot restaurant. Success can take surprising forms, as one keeps putting all their effort to realize their dreams!

results.title: Drink and Be Merry
results.overview: At a struggling New York dive bar in the days leading up to Christmas 2019, Chet, a beleaguered bartender in a state of extended arrested development, must balance caring for his misanthropic, aging regulars — who have nowhere else to go, and rely on him for far more than pouring drinks — with his naive desires to muster some Christmas spirit.

results.title: Local One
results.overview: An exploration into the first days of the strike at two Amazon warehouses in New York City.

results.title: Can I Get a Witness?
results.overview: In the not-too-distant future, we have solved all the world’s problems, mitigated climate change, eradicated poverty, and achieved true trans-species equality. There’s just one catch… humans have to end life at 50, and teenage artists have to document it. It’s Kiah’s first day on the job.

results.title: Nephilim
results.overview: In a harsh and frozen land near the North Pole, Arctic explorer Frederick finds salvation and his last companion in the only member of a long-extinct species: the giant Nephilim.

results.title: Thin Walls
results.overview: sounds coming from beyond their thin walls.

results.title: Beyond
results.overview: At Sing Sing prison, a group of incarcerated men share their passions, thoughts, and aspirations in a unique speaking event

results.title: A Heart Full of Hope
results.overview: In Willow Creek, sisters Whitney and Lynette face the challenges of Whitney's kidney failure together. As Whitney pursues her college dream, a kind teacher, Sebastian, is inspired by her strength. When he offers to donate his kidney, his selfless act sparks hope, love, and a life-saving donor chain that transforms their community.

results.title: Can You Stand The Rain
results.overview: Old friends reunite after their childhood anchor dies, forcing them to face buried dreams, tensions, and regrets while discovering their true selves and future possibilities.

results.title: The Barbie Movie
results.overview: Equal parts documentary, visual essay, experimental collage narrative, and parodic homage to and of all things Barbie, this caustic and exciting visual foray embraces the complicated terrain of feminist discourse, cultural criticism, and political rhetoric, as well as insights on gender, identity, and personal experience where all roads lead back to the phenomena that is Barbie.
